replicateCountMeaning: Fixed engineering Monte Carlo budget; not a statistical acceptance threshold or sufficient-tail-sample claim
observationWeight: -log(uniform), one positive exponential likelihood multiplier per original match
sharedDraws: FT and HT use the same original-event likelihood multipliers; HT exclusions remain in its original input denominator
replicateWeights: 1 / replicatesPerLeague; algorithmic Monte Carlo weights, not source-observed scenario probabilities
failurePolicy: Retain every attempted replicate and its reason; never replace, select favorable fits, or renormalize surviving replicate weights
fitPolicy: Preserve the existing frozen baseline cutoff, selected half-life, penalty, dependence grid, original rows and training hashes; use the existing optimizer with maxIterations 6000 and tolerance 0.000001
halfTimeFitPolicy: Preserve the existing frozen HT cutoff and selected half-life; conditional binomial exposure fit uses the same per-match likelihood multipliers as FT
sourcePolicy: Read only the committed normalized FT and enriched HT gzip histories; verify original IDs, scores, timestamps and source receipts, and preserve original source hashes
historicalAvailability: Historical scores and HT observations were backfilled at their original collection times; missing source publication times remain unknown
diagnosticPolicy: The reused 2025 development diagnostic is not a new untouched OOS test; no model selection, calibration improvement or betting-return claim is made here
interpretation: Parameter-sensitivity research under an explicit independent-match exponential likelihood-reweighting assumption; not an empirical model-error margin, confidence interval, scenario-probability estimate or formal R
